headline: Mooring County Loses a Strongpoint; Weathered Expanse Sees Fresh Moves
war_summary: Since the last edition, the clearest map-level change is on the Mooring County card: it stood at twelve Warden strongpoints and now shows eleven Warden and one Colonial, with two base events in the latest two-hour window. Weathered Expanse still reads five Colonial strongpoints to four Warden, after three fresh events in the same window; Frostmarch remains the busiest point with 26 changes on the daily card. LinnMercy shows ten Colonial strongpoints and one Warden, with no base event in the latest two hours but sharply rising casualty figures—1,340 Colonial and 1,913 Warden losses in that interval. Stlican Shelf keeps its five-four Warden-Colonial split; Stonecradle likewise stands five-four, though its last recorded event is older. Fisherman's Row, all nine strongpoints Colonial, carried 35 events in the past day and has quieted, its latest recorded at 18:41. Callahan's Passage and the Nevish Line continue heavy loss lists without recorded base flips. No victor declared on day 296.
